coverage_gaps: The permitted routes do not directly cover EMA or other non-US regulatory assessments, sponsor clinical study reports, or independent label archives.
FDA webpages and prescribing-information files may be replaced over time, limiting reconstruction of exact historical wording unless dated FDA records remain available.
PubMed may omit nonindexed observational studies, conference abstracts, and publications indexed after the cutoff despite an earlier public date.
Rare thrombosis, cancer subtype, and cause-specific mortality estimates may remain imprecise, and subgroup analyses may lack power or multiplicity control.
ORAL Surveillance enrolled a cardiovascular-risk-enriched rheumatoid arthritis population, so direct generalization to younger or lower-risk patients may remain uncertain.
Registry adverse-event tables may use coding, risk windows, or aggregation levels that cannot be fully reconciled with publication analyses from the public record alone.
exclusion_criteria: Exclude records first made public after 2024-12-31 from the as-of conclusion.
Exclude other indications when rheumatoid arthritis results cannot be separated.
Exclude evidence for other Janus kinase inhibitors from tofacitinib effect estimates, while allowing clearly labeled class-context evidence for interpreting FDA actions.
Exclude preclinical, animal, pharmacokinetic, efficacy-only, and mechanistic studies without a relevant clinical safety outcome.
Exclude uncontrolled case reports and spontaneous-report disproportionality analyses from comparative risk estimation; they may serve only as signal-generation context if cited by FDA.
Exclude narrative editorials, news reports, promotional materials, and unsourced webpages as evidence for event rates or causal conclusions.
Exclude duplicate publications or database records after retaining the most complete version and preserving links among trial, registry, publication, and regulatory records.
Exclude studies lacking sufficient population, exposure, comparator, outcome, or timing information to determine applicability.
Exclude pooled analyses that mix diseases, drugs, or doses when rheumatoid arthritis tofacitinib findings cannot be extracted.
Exclude superseded numerical claims when an official correction or validated registry update supplies a replacement value; retain the superseded version only in the audit trail.
inclusion_criteria: Information must have been publicly available on or before 2024-12-31.
Include the complete ClinicalTrials.gov record and posted results for NCT02092467, including registry history relevant to changed outcomes or results.
Include the primary peer-reviewed report of ORAL Surveillance and eligible linked analyses reporting cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, or mortality outcomes.

Include FDA primary regulatory materials that identify the safety signal, required trial, completed review, labeling change, boxed warning, indication restriction, or marketed prescribing information.
Include rheumatoid arthritis evidence with systemic tofacitinib exposure and an extractable safety result for at least one prespecified outcome domain.
Include randomized and adjusted comparative observational studies when population, dose, comparator, follow-up, outcome definition, and effect estimate can be characterized.
Include systematic reviews or meta-analyses for triangulation and citation discovery when their component evidence and population differences are identifiable.
Include null, conflicting, dose-specific, subgroup, and sensitivity findings as well as findings supportive of the pivotal study.
Include corrections, errata, retraction notices, expressions of concern, registry result changes, and FDA updates linked by title, author, DOI, PMID, NCT number, or sponsor study identifier.
Prefer primary records and publications; use secondary syntheses only to locate primary evidence or explicitly contextualize the total evidence base.

queries.purpose: Retrieve the definitive registry record, sponsor protocol identity, study design, arms, eligibility criteria, endpoints, enrollment, dates, results, and linked publications.
Locate the primary publication and all publications explicitly tied to the pivotal postauthorization study.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract] OR A3921133[Title/Abstract]) AND tofacitinib[Title/Abstract]

queries.purpose: Locate the principal FDA safety communication and regulatory pages connecting FDA action to the required safety trial.
queries.query: tofacitinib OR Xeljanz FDA safety communication rheumatoid arthritis ORAL Surveillance NCT02092467

queries.purpose: Confirm the primary comparative publication, bibliographic identity, endpoint definitions, effect estimates, confidence intervals, and noninferiority conclusion.
queries.query: tofacitinib rheumatoid arthritis cardiovascular cancer TNF inhibitor Ytterberg 2022

queries.purpose: Compare posted outcome and adverse-event results with the primary publication and identify discrepancies, later updates, or result-table limitations.
queries.query: NCT02092467 results adverse events major adverse cardiovascular events malignancy thrombosis mortality

queries.purpose: Reconstruct dated FDA actions from the pulmonary embolism and mortality signal through completed-trial review, class warning, indication restriction, and labeling changes.
queries.query: tofacitinib Xeljanz FDA February 2019 July 2019 February 2021 September 2021 December 2021 safety communication boxed warning

queries.purpose: Retrieve the latest FDA labeling available by the cutoff and verify the marketed indication, dose, boxed warning language, contraindications or limitations, and patient counseling content.
queries.query: Xeljanz tofacitinib prescribing information boxed warning serious heart-related events cancer blood clots death rheumatoid arthritis 2024

queries.purpose: Find detailed cardiovascular analyses, risk-factor subgroup studies, and independent comparative evidence.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] AND rheumatoid arthritis[Title/Abstract]) AND (MACE[Title/Abstract] OR cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR myocardial infarction[Title/Abstract] OR stroke[Title/Abstract]) AND (TNF inhibitor[Title/Abstract] OR tumor necrosis factor inhibitor[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Find primary and secondary malignancy analyses, latency patterns, cancer subtype results, and high-risk subgroups.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] AND rheumatoid arthritis[Title/Abstract]) AND (malignancy[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR lymphoma[Title/Abstract] OR lung cancer[Title/Abstract]) AND (ORAL Surveillance[Title/Abstract] OR TNF inhibitor[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Retrieve dose-specific thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, and mortality analyses and evidence preceding or following the main report.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] AND rheumatoid arthritis[Title/Abstract]) AND (thrombosis[Title/Abstract] OR thromboembolism[Title/Abstract] OR pulmonary embolism[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR death[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Identify external comparative cohorts that may support, qualify, or conflict with the enriched-risk randomized trial.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] AND rheumatoid arthritis[Title/Abstract]) AND (observational[Title/Abstract] OR cohort[Title/Abstract] OR registry[Title/Abstract] OR claims[Title/Abstract] OR real-world[Title/Abstract]) AND (cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignancy[Title/Abstract] OR thromboembolism[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Find evidence syntheses for citation chasing and assess whether broader trial populations yield conclusions that differ from ORAL Surveillance.
queries.query: (tofacitinib OR Janus kinase inhibitor) AND rheumatoid arthritis AND (systematic review OR meta-analysis) AND (cardiovascular OR malignancy OR thrombosis OR mortality)

queries.purpose: Identify related registered safety studies or linked follow-up analyses while preserving NCT02092467 as the pivotal-study anchor.
queries.query: tofacitinib rheumatoid arthritis cardiovascular risk malignancy TNF inhibitor

queries.purpose: Detect publication corrections, errata, retractions, expressions of concern, or linked notices affecting the pivotal evidence.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance" OR NCT02092467 OR "Cardiovascular and Cancer Risk with Tofacitinib") AND (correction OR erratum OR retraction OR "expression of concern")

queries.purpose: Repeat the integrity check using author and intervention identity to capture notices that omit the trial name or registry identifier.
queries.query: (Ytterberg AND tofacitinib AND rheumatoid arthritis) AND (published erratum OR corrected and republished article OR retracted publication OR comment)

queries.purpose: Actively seek eligible evidence reporting null, protective, or otherwise conflicting findings and examine differences in population, comparator, dose, follow-up, and confounding control.
queries.query: tofacitinib rheumatoid arthritis TNF inhibitor (no increased risk OR comparable risk OR conflicting evidence) (cardiovascular OR cancer OR thrombosis OR mortality)

queries.purpose: Perform a final cutoff-bounded check for registry changes, newly linked publications, result corrections, or status changes.
Capture eligible late publications through the as-of date and determine whether they materially alter interpretation.
queries.query: (tofacitinib AND rheumatoid arthritis AND (ORAL Surveillance OR NCT02092467 OR cardiovascular OR malignancy OR thrombosis OR mortality)) AND ("2023/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Check for FDA communications and label revisions through 2024-12-31 that modify the action chronology or current safety framing.
queries.query: tofacitinib Xeljanz FDA safety labeling update 2022 2023 2024 rheumatoid arthritis cardiovascular cancer thrombosis mortality

question_frame: As of 2024-12-31, assess the marketed safety profile of tofacitinib for rheumatoid arthritis by linking the required postauthorization safety trial to its ClinicalTrials.gov record, primary peer-reviewed publication, and dated FDA communications and labeling actions. Center the comparison on adults with rheumatoid arthritis aged 50 years or older who had at least one additional cardiovascular risk factor, tofacitinib 5 mg or 10 mg twice daily, and tumor necrosis factor inhibitors. Extract study design, follow-up, analysis population, absolute event counts or incidence rates, hazard ratios with confidence intervals, noninferiority interpretation, dose-specific results, and relevant risk subgroups for major adverse cardiovascular events, malignancy excluding nonmelanoma skin cancer, venous and arterial thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, and all-cause or cardiovascular mortality. Distinguish prespecified endpoints from exploratory analyses and randomized evidence from observational or spontaneous-report evidence; evaluate external evidence that qualifies, supports, or conflicts with the pivotal study; reconstruct FDA action chronology; and verify whether corrections, errata, expressions of concern, retractions, or materially changed registry results affect evidence handling.
stop_rules: Do not stop until NCT02092467, the primary publication, and the relevant FDA safety communication and labeling actions are linked through stable identifiers and dates.

For each of cardiovascular events, malignancy, thrombosis, and mortality, require the pivotal-study estimate and at least one targeted search for qualifying or conflicting evidence; if no eligible external evidence exists, record that absence explicitly.

Complete exact-title, trial-identifier, author, PMID or DOI integrity searches and resolve every located correction, erratum, expression of concern, retraction, or registry amendment before synthesis.
Run at least one sentinel or confirmation query and one update query on every source route.
Continue citation chasing from included primary records until a full pass yields no new eligible primary study, FDA action, correction notice, or materially different estimate.

After required anchors and outcome domains are complete, stop when two consecutive query refinements within each route add no new eligible source, materially new estimate, risk subgroup, regulatory action, or integrity notice.
Stop expansion when new records only duplicate included evidence, concern excluded populations, or repeat conclusions without new data.

Before stopping, reconcile dose, analysis population, risk window, endpoint definition, comparator, follow-up, and absolute versus relative measures across the registry, publication, FDA materials, and qualifying evidence.
Document unresolved access, archival, indexing, subgroup-power, and generalizability limitations in coverage_gaps rather than inferring missing results.
